messages:
Marco: Tiny Tree Desk Decor Challenge! Who's in? Make a mini tree (<=12") using desk stuff, post a pic, reactions decide the winner. Deadline Friday 5pm PT :trophy: :evergreen_tree:
Sasha: I'm so in! will do glitter + paperclip ornaments :sparkles:
Devon: Rules suggestion: creativity, desk-appropriateness, and holiday vibes. also points for recycled materials.
Lina: Love it. I'll help judge — can we make a 3-person panel? (me, marco, devon)
Mike: can my office bonsai count if I drape it in fairy lights? :eyes:
Alyssa: yes! free accessories allowed. posting mine now — tiny tree made from sticky notes + paper straw star https://imgur.com/placeholder.jpg :heart:
Jen: HA love that. also putting a "no glitter confetti" clause unless you clean it up :sweat_smile:
Marco: rule added: glitter is allowed but you commit to vacuuming your area 😂
Sasha: quick poll idea: react with :1st_place_medal: if you'd vote for Alyssa, :2nd_place_medal: for Mike, :3rd_place_medal: for Sasha (i will self-nominate)
Devon: Or just react to each pic, more organic. Friday evening we'll tally reactions.
Ops-bot: Reminder set: "Mini Tree Challenge voting ends" on 2026-12-18 17:00 PT
Lina: tiny trophy will be a virtual emoji award and a custom slack status for the winner :trophy:
Mike: ok posting mine in 5
Sasha: posted! https://imgur.com/placeholder2.jpg — made from a stapler + paperclips :metal:
Marco: posted mine too. surprise: gif included :D https://imgur.com/placeholder3.gif
Alyssa: bookmarked all — may the shiniest tree win :sparkles:
Devon: also kudos for sustainability winners get a $25 donation to a tree-planting charity? Thoughts?
Jen: love that idea. yes please
Marco: done — charity add-on if the panel picks sustainability winner :seedling:
Lina: voting starts now. drop reactions on photos until Friday 5pm. may the best tiny tree win!
